notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Patch 1.4 Major: 

Fixed dialogue inconsistencies

New and updated UI elements

Removed two newly discovered softlocks

Updated character portrait for Elliot

New portrait expressions for Julia

New, deeper dialogue branches for some conversations

Fixed some NPC not being clickable during certain day states



 Minor: 

Fixed typos

Conversant names not showing up in some parts

Fixed some interactables not highlighting

Fixed minor navigation issues

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Patch 1.3 Major 

Fixed dialogue inconsistencies

Fixed not being able to load saves after end credits without restarting

Removed newly discovered softlock

 Minor 

Fixed sound issues

Added new UI elements

Corrected fonts in some UI elements

Fixed newly discovered typos

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Major



Fixed soft locks in the story that we hadn’t anticipated

Fixed issues with characters appearing in the wrong places—or not appearing at all when they should

Fixed a bug where saving could lock the game in certain scenes



Minor



Fixed typos

Resolved looping conversations

Gave some UI elements a visual overhaul

Helpful tips for challenging parts of the game

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Patch notes 1.1


Major

Removed debug console showing

Performance improvements in the kitchen and the oilrig levels

Inner voices not appearing if saved and loaded to the first dreamland level

Seashells now stay in inventory when changing locations



Minor

More variation to different character poses in conversations

Footstep sounds altered

Save/Load button font fixed
